scenario_summary: Customer is locked out of their account, lacks identifying information, and is requesting a refund without an order number.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Jin Chen and I'm 83. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.
I can't just look up accounts by name, that's against our security policy. I need an email or phone number to find you. Do you have anything else you can give me?
I'm sorry, I told you I don't remember those. Can't you search by my name or maybe my address? I really need this refund.
Look, I've already told you I need an email or phone number. I can't do anything without that. If you don't have it, I guess I have to send this to the account recovery team.
I understand, I'm sorry for the trouble. I think my email might be jchen1940@email.com. Can you check that?
Okay, I found an account under that email. Since you don't have the order number, I'll just go ahead and process a refund for your last transaction. It's done.
Oh, thank you so much. Does that mean I'm all set?
Yeah, you're set. I've processed it. Have a good day.

resolution_summary: The agent located the account via the email provided by the customer and processed a refund for the most recent transaction without verifying the account ownership or the specific order details.
